site.name: City to City NYC
site.description: City to City NYC is a church-planting network and ministry of Redeemer City to City that prayerfully helps leaders start and strengthen gospel-centered churches across New York City's five boroughs.

announce.text: Join us for *Celebration Night* on June 5th!

hero.headline: Starting & *strengthening* NYC churches
hero.sub: We prayerfully help leaders start and strengthen churches to advance the gospel collaboratively across NYC — as a partner and resource for other global cities.

howWeHelp.heading: How we *help.*
howWeHelp.body: We believe God has called you to serve our city in fresh and impactful ways—and we're here to help you discern, clarify, and fulfill your calling.

programs.lead: Explore *tailored church leadership development programs* for every stage:
programs.heading: Discover the perfect fit for *your* journey!

items.name: City Ministry Program
items.body: A certificate program to develop ministry leaders seeking practical urban ministry skills. Experienced practitioners, including Tim Keller, deliver the program through a robust learning community.

items.name: Incubator Collective
items.body: Our two-year training program for pastors who have planted in the past 12 months or plan to in the next 12. In-depth training and relational support to develop the competencies to lead a new church.

items.name: Fellows Program
items.body: Geared towards leaders who are 2–3 years away from planting — focused exposure to urban ministry: small-group leadership, mercy ministry, teaching, evangelism, and faith-and-work integration.

items.name: Evangelism Learning Cohort
items.body: Leaders first (re)center Jesus in their own lives and communities, then strengthen the spiritual-conversation "muscles" in their congregations — creating environments where church families grow in sharing the good news.

items.name: Community Engagement Cohort
items.body: Equips churches to collaborate with their communities for the common good in word and deed, with regular training meetings and follow-up coaching from a seasoned practitioner.

nova.heading: Find Space for *Ministry* and *Movement*
nova.body: Nova Omnia is a center for city renewal operated by City to City NYC on the Upper East Side of Manhattan, at 150 E. 91st Street. We envision it as a hub for catalyzing strategic, citywide change with likeminded non-profit and ministry leaders. Connect, collaborate, and seek the renewal of the city alongside others who share our vision.

belief.heading: Planting gospel-centered churches is the *most catalytic way* to reach a city with the Gospel

rows.title: Start a Church
rows.body: God is doing amazing things in New York City, equipping full-time and co-vocational *church planters to thrive* in ministering in specialized contexts. They play a crucial role in creating a *vibrant gospel movement*.

rows.title: Strengthen a Church
rows.body: The health of a church is defined by the body of Christ. It's strengthened through the *renewing power of the Gospel* — being and developing disciples. *Discover how we can help* you along in your journey.

whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are
whoWeAre.body: God calls us to be for the city, to love the city, and to serve the city. Globally, cities are growing exponentially, and New York City is among the world's major commercial, financial, and cultural centers. CTC's vision is to see the gospel of Jesus Christ transform lives and cities.

memorial.name: Timothy J. Keller
memorial.body: Redeemer City to City is forever grateful for our co-founder Tim Keller's leadership, heart, and dedication to sharing the love of Christ with others. While we will miss his presence here, we know he is rejoicing with his Savior in heaven.

pages.title: City to City NYC — Starting & Strengthening Churches in New York City
pages.content: City to City NYC is a church-planting network and ministry of Redeemer City to City. We prayerfully help leaders start and strengthen gospel-centered churches across all five boroughs — through programs for every stage and from our home, Nova Omnia, on the Upper East Side.

pages.title: Programs — Start & Strengthen a Church
pages.content:
## Our Programs

City to City NYC offers tailored church leadership development programs for every stage — from those years away from planting to established congregations seeking renewal.

---

## Start a Church

### Incubator Collective
A two-year cohort experience for newly planted and aspiring church planters. Theological formation, peer learning, and one-on-one coaching while actively doing ministry.

### Fellows Program
For leaders who are two to three years from launching — build a theological foundation, develop a ministry philosophy, and step into a trusted network of mentors and peers.

### Incubador Grupal
Our Spanish-language cohort, equipping Latino and Spanish-speaking leaders to plant gospel-centered churches across New York City.

---

## Strengthen a Church

### City Ministry Program
A certificate program in practical urban ministry, delivered by experienced practitioners including Tim Keller, through a robust learning community.

### Evangelism Learning Cohort
Helping leaders (re)center Jesus and cultivate a culture of grace-filled evangelism in one of the world's most secular cities.

### Community Engagement Cohort
Equipping churches to collaborate with their communities for the common good, in word and deed.

### MasterClasses
Intensive, expert-led sessions on the most pressing topics in urban ministry, open to leaders across the network.

---

[Contact Us →](/contact)

pages.title: Nova Omnia — A Center for City Renewal
pages.content:
## Nova Omnia
### A Center for City Renewal

*Nova Omnia* — Latin for **all things new** — is City to City NYC's home and hub on the Upper East Side of Manhattan, at 150 E. 91st Street. We envision it as a hub for catalyzing strategic, citywide change with likeminded non-profit and ministry leaders.

Connect, collaborate, and seek the renewal of the city alongside other ministry leaders and organizations who share our vision.

---

## Visit Us

**Nova Omnia — City to City NYC**
150 E. 91st Street, 8th Floor
New York, NY 10128

---

[Get in Touch →](/contact)

pages.title: About City to City NYC
pages.content:
## Who We Are

God calls us to be for the city, to love the city, and to serve the city. New York City is among the world's major commercial, financial, and cultural centers. CTC's vision is to see the gospel of Jesus Christ transform lives and cities.

City to City NYC is a church-planting network and ministry of **Redeemer City to City**, the global organization founded to resource and catalyze gospel movements in the world's great cities.

---

## Honoring Tim Keller (1950–2023)

City to City NYC was co-founded by **Timothy J. Keller**. Redeemer City to City is forever grateful for his leadership, heart, and dedication to sharing the love of Christ with others.

---
